original_test_intent: Verify uncorrectable ECRC handling for both transmit and receive directions on the approved GPU PCIe link, including the expected AER/driver containment and complete recovery without an unresolved host or device failure.
original_method: Record GPU/BDF/root-port/link/driver/tool/firmware and workload state; preserve AER/dmesg/lspci baseline; safely load ras_enable=1 and retain source UMC query as limited precheck; approve target, Table3.14 modes and expected severity/containment; run ECRC TX mode2 once; collect direction-specific endpoint/root-port AER/status/header/driver/SEL evidence and execute approved recovery; establish clean enumeration/link baseline; only then run ECRC RX mode3 once; repeat evidence/recovery; verify no ongoing AER storm, device loss or host hang and restore settings.
manual_activity: PCIe/AMD platform owner approves BDF/root-port target, Table3.14 direction/severity/containment, recovery and phase order; agent may observe each approved phase once with recovery gate.
required_inputs: AMD GPU RAS Tool guide Table3.14 plus expected endpoint/root-port AER status/mask/severity/header fields
Expected DPC/reset/device-loss behavior and criteria for acceptable recovered versus failed containment
Approved PCIe/GPU reset/hot reset/reboot/OOB recovery, phase rebaseline and ras_enable restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated isolated SUT with tested OOB recovery and no GPU workloads
Preserve AER/link/host baseline and verify console access before injection
Never run TX/RX concurrently or back-to-back without approved recovery/rebaseline
Stop on unexpected fatality, root-port containment mismatch, device loss, hang, AER storm or recovery failure
No retry or independent reset/hot reset/reboot
agent_execution_scope: Validate guide/tool/module, topology, target and baseline
Observe one approved TX phase, collect containment evidence and owner recovery; only after gate, observe RX
Verify final enumeration/link/GPU/host health and restore settings
Do not select severity/order, proceed after failed recovery, retry, reset independently or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve target and Table3.14 ECRC direction/severity mapping

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete and severity-ambiguous: it omits exact mode2 TX/mode3 RX, Table3.14 and endpoint/root-port containment fields; `no hang` alone is not an uncorrectable ECRC oracle.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain module/source UMC precheck; run `sudo amdgpuras -b5 -s1 -t4 -m2` once, recover/rebaseline under owner control, then if authorized run `sudo amdgpuras -b5 -s1 -t4 -m3` once; capture complete AER/status/header/dmesg/lspci/link/SEL evidence per phase.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Block5, subtype1, type4, mode2 ECRC TX, mode3 ECRC RX, Table3.14, success/dmesg criteria, Common branch and30/30 minutes are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute two isolated ECRC direction phases with explicit containment expectations and a human-controlled recovery/rebaseline barrier.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds topology, uncorrectable severity/AER fields, containment, phase separation and recovery authorization.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic hardware-error line plus final lspci cannot show whether endpoint/root-port containment and severity matched for each ECRC direction.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Uncorrectable ECRC can trigger DPC, reset, device removal or host hang; the expected outcome is platform-policy dependent and cannot be guessed.

project_override_considerations: Do not turn device loss into automatic FAIL or PASS without Table3.14/platform containment policy, but always stop and recover. Do not proceed from TX to RX merely because the injection command returned success. Preserve the UMC query only as unrelated precheck coverage.
expected_evidence: GPU/BDF/root-port/downstream-link identity, driver/tool/module versions and Table3.14 mapping
Pre-event endpoint/root-port AER status/mask/severity, dmesg/SEL and lspci -vv link state
Mode2 TX transcript plus endpoint/root-port AER/header/containment and recovery evidence
Clean re-enumeration/rebaseline and explicit authorization for phase2
Mode3 RX transcript plus separate AER/header/containment and recovery evidence
No continuing AER storm/unresolved device loss/hang, final host/GPU/BMC health, restoration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The primary source explicitly specifies uncorrectable ECRC TX and RX as sequential steps with Table3.14. Missing severity/containment detail is an engineering input, not contradictory source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Both exact ECRC stimuli are defined; guide, target, containment oracle and recovery can be supplied.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row201 Wistron-GPU RAS-00016-V002: approve platform/BMC and implicit GPU UUID/OAM/BDF/root-port/downstream link, amdgpuras version/hash/license and Table3.14; confirm block5/subtype1/type4 mode2=ECRC TX and mode3=ECRC RX, expected endpoint/root-port AER status/mask/severity/header and DPC/reset/device-loss containment, recovered-PASS oracle, phase recovery/rebaseline authorization, source UMC-query boundary, and PCIe/GPU hot-reset/reboot/OOB no-retry recovery plus ras_enable restoration.

review_improvement: Makes the uncorrectable ECRC containment outcome and recovery barrier explicit while preserving both TX/RX source stimuli and preventing unsafe back-to-back execution.
independent_technical_reasoning: ECRC TX and RX can surface at different PCIe components, so endpoint and root-port AER registers/header logs must be correlated separately. Uncorrectable handling may legitimately include DPC or device reset depending on platform policy; `no hang` is too weak and absolute device presence may be too strict before approved recovery. Since phase1 can destroy the test path, phase2 is a new controlled experiment, not a continuation. Automatic retry or phase advance after containment failure would risk host availability and erase causality.
